title: Puppet Animation — An Idea Becomes a Connected System

scenes.title: Anticipation and lift
scenes.purpose: A wooden marionette on a night-blue miniature stage gathers weight and lifts an unlit idea (bulb) overhead.
visuals: Three.js miniature stage: painted night cyclorama, oak plank floor, oxblood velvet curtains
Wooden marionette rig with walnut joints and strings to a control bar
Brass-capped glass bulb in the raised hand
Heading: ACT I · SCENE II / An Idea Becomes a Connected System

beats.development: Heading fades in; marionette sinks into a deeper crouch with feet planted (anticipation).
captions: An Idea Becomes a Connected System

beats.development: Marionette pushes up through its legs and raises the bulb overhead; the bulb lights with a small pop and warms the set.

scenes.title: Connections
scenes.purpose: Red yarn threads carry the idea to miniature houses that hinge upright and light up, forming a connected system.
visuals: Yarn tubes drawing from bulb to three houses, then house 3 to house 4
Painted-wood houses hinging from lying flat to upright with lit windows
Marionette turns head and body to regard the system; control bar settles

beats.development: Threads 1–3 travel in staggered order; each house stands up as its thread arrives, windows light.
House 3 passes the connection to house 4, which stands and lights; puppet turns toward the houses in follow-through.

scenes.title: Settled tableau
scenes.purpose: Hold the complete, legible connected system and heading.
visuals: Static final pose: lit bulb, four lit houses joined by yarn, readable heading

beats.development: All motion settled; final tableau holds for reading.
captions: An Idea Becomes a Connected System

findings: Heading is fully legible from 0.5 s and stays still for the remaining 2.5 s.
Primary focus moves puppet → bulb → threads/houses in eye-trace order, left to right.
Poses are held on twos (15 exposures/s) at 30 fps delivery to read as stop-motion posing; this is a digital approximation.
justifiedHolds: 2.55–3.0 s final tableau hold so the completed system and heading read clearly.

notes: Digital marionette rig rendered in Three.js; not photographed physical puppets.

No reviewed preview recipes in STYLE.json and BACKGROUND_REVIEW has 0 matched sources (no contact sheets), so the original puppet craft is kept; the background is a scene-chosen night cyclorama instead of the earlier cream swatch.
